purpose: AdSense/search quality review before re-indexing private certificate detail pages

policy.A: Certificate-specific content, independently useful guidance and verifiable source support are sufficient for indexing.
policy.B: The subject has recovery value but still needs deeper certificate-specific content or source support before indexing.
policy.C: High duplication/ambiguity risk or weak independent qualification value; keep noindex until a deeper rewrite.

p1DeepReview.result: 12 of 15 P1 pages promoted to A after page-level rewrites and source verification; 3 remain B/noindex.

approved.coding-instructor: Exact PQI coding-instructor registration and grade duties verified; page rewritten around coding plus lesson design and mock teaching.

held.web-design-specialist: Content was deeply rewritten and W3C WCAG 2.2 provides strong standards support, but an exact representative private qualification registration/operator was not confirmed in this pass.

p1DeepReview.indexing: Only the 12 approved slugs are in APPROVED_PRIVATE_SLUGS. The three held P1 pages remain noindex.

notes: A promotion requires a substantive page-level rewrite; adding only search-intent answers is not sufficient.
Only A slugs are re-indexed. B and C pages remain noindex.
P1 held pages should not be promoted merely to meet a target count; exact qualification identity and source support must be resolved first.
The next recovery pool is P2 after any desired follow-up verification of the three held P1 pages.
